tagline: Read together, whatever edition you hold.

home.noClubs: No clubs yet. Start one and invite your friends, or join with an invite link or code.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back.
signIn.accountDeleted: Your account was deleted. Thank you for reading with us.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Join a club, log your page, leave notes for the others.
signUp.name: Your name
signUp.nameHint: Shown to the people in your clubs.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.signup: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to finish creating your account.
checkEmail.unverified: Confirm your email first. We sent a new link to {{email}}.
checkEmail.reset: If there's an account for {{email}}, we sent it a link to choose a new password. The link works for 1 hour.
checkEmail.spam: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.doneBody: You've been signed out everywhere. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidBody: Reset links work once, for 1 hour. Ask for a new one.

confirmed.title: Email confirmed
confirmed.invalidBody: Confirmation links work once, for 24 hours. Sign in and we'll send you a new one.

errors.passwordCompromised: This password has appeared in a known data breach. Choose a different one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.googleNotLinked: This email already has a Bookclub account that isn't confirmed yet. Confirm it with the link we emailed, then Google sign-in will work too.
errors.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't work. Try again, or use your email and password.
errors.googleEmailMismatch: That Google account uses a different email address. You can only connect a Google account with the same address as your Bookclub account.
errors.googleTaken: That Google account is already connected to another Bookclub account.

server.degraded: Server reachable, but its database is not answering

account.title: Account
account.name: Your name
account.nameHint: Shown to the people in your clubs.
account.emailNote: Your sign-in address. It's never shown to other members.
account.passwordNotSet: Not set: you sign in with Google.
account.addPasswordSent: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to choose a password.
account.disconnectNeedsPassword: Add a password before disconnecting Google, so you can still sign in.
account.googleDisconnected: Google disconnected. Sign in with your password from now on.
account.devicesCount_one: You're signed in on this device only.
account.devicesCount_other: You're signed in on {{count}} devices, including this one.
account.signOutOthers: Sign out on all other devices
account.dataBody: Download everything Bookclub stores about you, as a JSON file.
account.dangerBody: Permanently delete your account and everything in it.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.body: This permanently deletes your profile, your sign-in methods and everything else stored with your account. It cannot be undone. Download your data first if you want to keep a copy.
deleteAccount.googleNote: You sign in with Google, so no password is needed.
deleteAccount.reauthBody: For your security, deleting an account without a password needs a sign-in from the last 24 hours. Sign out, sign in with Google again, then come back here.

books.title: Find a book
books.searchHint: The ISBN is on the back cover, above the barcode.
books.isbnInvalid: That ISBN isn't valid. Check the digits.
books.providerDown: The book catalogue isn't answering right now. Try again in a minute.
books.rateLimited: Slow down a little, then try again.
books.chooseEdition: Which edition do you have? Different editions have different page numbers.
books.filterLabel: Filter by publisher, year, language or ISBN
books.notListed: Don't see yours? Search for its ISBN instead, or add it by hand.

edition.source_manual: Added by hand by a reader.
edition.clubsNote: Pick this edition for a club from the club page: "Choose the book" opens this search in picking mode.

manual.title: Add a book by hand
manual.subtitle: For books the catalogues don't know. Other readers can find it by its ISBN afterwards.
manual.pageCountHint: The last numbered page of the story.
manual.pagesInvalid: Enter a whole number of pages.

errors.not_found: This club doesn't exist, or you're not a member.
errors.forbidden: Only the club's owner or admins can do that.
errors.owner_cannot_leave: Hand the club to someone else before you leave.
errors.too_many_clubs: You already own 20 clubs, which is the limit.
errors.edition_without_pages: This edition has no page count. Pick another edition, or add yours by hand with its page count.
errors.page_out_of_range: That page isn't in the club's edition.
errors.finish_before_start: The finish date is before the start date.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

create.title: Start a club
create.subtitle: You'll be the owner. Invite people afterwards with a link.
create.name: Club name
create.descriptionHint: What you read, when you meet: anything new members should know.

join.title: Join a club
join.subtitle: Paste the invite link, or type the code someone gave you.
join.invalid: That doesn't look like an invite code. Codes have 8 letters and digits, like ABCD-EFGH.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.full: This club is full, so it can't take new members right now.
invite.invalid: This invite link doesn't work. It may have been replaced by a newer one: ask for a fresh link.
invite.signInFirst: Sign in or create an account to join. We will bring you back here.

club.finishQuestion: Mark this book as finished? It moves to past books, and you can choose the next one.
club.inviteBody: Anyone with this link can join while there is room ({{count}} of {{cap}} places taken).
club.newLinkQuestion: Make a new invite link? The old link and code stop working.

book.title: Book dates
book.finishHint: The pace line in the reading chart aims for this date.
book.chosen: This is the club book now.

meeting.name: Title
meeting.readToHint: In the club edition, {{edition}}, which has {{pages}} pages.
meeting.invalidDateTime: Choose a date and a time.

member.adminHint: Admins can edit the club, choose the book, plan meetings and remove members.
member.makeOwnerQuestion: Make {{name}} the owner? You become an admin, and only the new owner can undo this.
member.removeQuestion: Remove {{name}} from the club? They can rejoin with the invite link unless you make a new one.

settings.title: Club settings
settings.leaveQuestion: Leave {{name}}? You can rejoin with an invite link.
settings.ownerLeaveHint: As the owner, hand the club to another member (on their member page) before you leave.
settings.deleteQuestion: Delete {{name}} for everyone? Its books, meetings and member list are removed. This cannot be undone.
